recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not add a parallel ValueSet example for this historical issue because the accepted resolution intentionally moved the use case to CodeSystem; handle any future terminology-service parameter-table refinements under their own current Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-12700 was a Published/Persuasive vocab change request asking for an example that validates a code directly against a known code system with no value set specified. The final resolution directed that the operation be added to the CodeSystem resource for STU4.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 12757, imported as git commit aa22ace2ba333228a87b6fcbbf0c4f8db71de7ad with subject '#12700 - add $validate-code to code system'. That commit added CodeSystem $validate-code request and response example files and operation source content.
additional_context: The 2017 Zulip terminology discussion distinguished code-system membership validation from value-set membership validation and recorded that GF#12700 was voted to add $validate-code to CodeSystem. Later related Jira issues and commits corrected terminology-module links, stale ValueSet wording, and JSON/example defects without reversing the CodeSystem operation decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini keeps CodeSystem and ValueSet in build scope; the current CodeSystem OperationDefinition declares $validate-code, points to request/response examples, and the request example begins with instance-level validation against CodeSystem/loinc.

related_jiras.note: Added the new CodeSystem $validate-code operation to the Terminology Module after FHIR-12700 introduced the operation.

Fixed the CodeableConcept.coding array shape in the same example.
